description: Squash-merge logical contradiction. Design line 50 mandates the squash-merge production flow; predicate 3 (unmerged_into_trunk) uses `git rev-list --count <trunk>..<branch> > 0`. After a squash-merge the branch commits are unreachable from trunk under their original SHAs, so rev-list returns >0 permanently -> every squash-merged worktree is classified ACTIVE forever and is NEVER reapable. The spec mentions squash zero times.

evidence.snippet: `unmerged_into_trunk`: `git rev-list --count <trunk>..<branch> > 0` — at least one commit on the branch is not reachable from the repo's trunk ref.

fix: Detect squash-merge via `git cherry trunk branch` / patch-id / `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt`; define mergedIntoTrunk TRUE for squash-merged branches; add EARS clause + edge cases for squash vs merge-commit vs rebase.
